_comment: Level 2 — grants the write actions. Attach ALONGSIDE the AWS managed policy
Why the managed policy is also needed: CloudFormation deletes a stack using
the CALLER's permissions, so deleting this stack requires permission to
delete everything inside it — Cognito user pool, Lambda functions, DynamoDB
tables, API Gateway, IAM roles. Hand-listing those is how a stack ends up
stuck in DELETE_FAILED halfway through, which is worse than where it started.
Scope: the Resource entries below are deliberately narrowed to this app id.
Change d32nf9wwqqt016 if you point the script at another app.
